visualCharacteristics.purpose: Promotional text with CTA beside a photo
visualCharacteristics.description: 50/50 split: text (heading, paragraphs, CTA) on the left vertically centred, photo on the right filling the band height; stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: text cell (H2, paragraphs, link) and image cell
contentPattern.rationale: Two different pieces of content side by side: Columns.

reuseGuidance: Use for a single promo next to a photo. For multiple look-alike teasers use cards-teaser.

blockContent.description: Text (title "Experience Cambria in Person", 2 paragraphs, CTA link) beside a kitchen photo

structure.notes: columns-moodboard: one row. Cell 1: Quintessa slab image + caption "Quintessa(TM)"; MacBeth image linked to /quartz-countertops/quartz-colors/designs/macbeth + caption; Charlestown image linked to /quartz-countertops/quartz-colors/designs/charlestown + caption. Cell 2: list of 4 paints, each "Name" (bold), "Benjamin Moore", hex (#d3c9bd Mocha Cream, #6f6151 Northwood Brown, #95917f Sage Mountain, #6d4243 Ruby Dusk); then 2 hardware images each with caption (Kohler Purist Semi-Pro in Vibrant Polished Nickel; Slab style in Dark Brown). columns-teaser: one row. Cell 1: H2 "Experience Cambria in Person", 2 paragraphs, link "Find Cambria near you" (/dealer-locator/locations). Cell 2: kitchen image.

usageDescription: Teaser band with heading, text and CTA next to a photo that fills its half. One row; text cell and image cell in either order.
